notes: Gold11 parallel AI relabel of sc_152f1b1aacb2 (40500000_0_SCAN2 1.ply, CG64C412CC73); human gold untouched. SCAN2 is an intermediate forming stage: base + two 44 mm side walls (one with a 49 mm inward top flange, the other with two 13-14 mm inward top tabs at its ends) + two 10 mm up-turned end tabs on the base short edges; the finished part's end walls are not bent yet. 7 formed folds, all ~90 deg, t~1.0 mm, Ri~1.3 mm (patch renders + 3 independent auditors; no joggles or shallow bends). Conventions: each base|wall fold is ONE line from wall end to wall end across its two ~29 mm ear windows (same two plates, collinear); the two top tabs are separate tab plates ~100 mm apart, so they are two lines (not a window-interrupted fold). Human lines M03-M06 run along flat wall faces / vertical cut edges (no fold), so they have no AI counterpart. Prep run once for this audit (no earlier bench_labeling prep of this scan existed).
